_comment: Everyday words for letter cards, as on a classic alphabet chart (क for कमल), for the ASER letters that have no picture word in pictures.json and no simple word on the language's ASER word cards. A Letter group's card shows the letter with one of these for its sound (api/app/llm/activities.py anchor_word; web/src/lib/content.ts letterCards). Letters that never begin a word (ळ, ण, ட, ள, ன) have none. AI-drafted, awaiting native-speaking reviewers.
